app.name: SmartDepo
app.tagline: Manage your depot's products, stock, sales, and customer credit in one place.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use the email address or phone number registered with your depot.
auth.registerSubtitle: Send your details to the Platform Admin. You can sign in after your depot is approved.
auth.noAccount: Do not have a depot account?
auth.depotNamePlaceholder: For example, Boeng Keng Kong Depot
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
auth.loginExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.sessionSuspended: Your depot has been suspended. Contact the Platform Admin for help.
auth.sessionRejected: Your depot registration was rejected. Contact the Platform Admin for help.
auth.sessionPending: Your depot is still waiting for approval.
auth.loginGenericError: We could not sign you in. Check your details and try again.

validation.passwordLength: Password must be between 8 and 72 characters.
validation.passwordComplexity: Password must contain at least one letter and one number.
validation.reasonLength: Enter a reason between 3 and 500 characters.
validation.currency: Use a three-letter currency code such as KHR or USD.
validation.quantity: Enter a quantity with up to 3 decimals.
validation.conversionFactor: Enter a factor greater than 0 and different from 1.
validation.sku: Use letters, digits, dot, underscore, or dash; start with a letter or digit.
validation.priceAmount: Enter an amount with up to 2 decimals.
validation.unitName: Unit names must be unique for this product.
validation.maxUnits: A product can have at most 20 extra units.
validation.quantityNotZero: Enter a quantity different from zero.
validation.paymentTerms: Enter the payment terms in days (0 to 365).

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.subtitle: Your depot registration is with the Platform Admin.
pending.registeredTitle: Thank you. Your depot is registered.
pending.registeredMessage: The Platform Admin will review your details. You can sign in after the depot is approved.
pending.stepReview: The Platform Admin reviews your depot information.
pending.stepDecision: You receive approval, or the registration is rejected with a reason.
pending.stepSignIn: After approval, sign in with your owner email or phone.
pending.checkLater: You can close this page. Your registration is saved.

rejected.title: Registration not approved
rejected.message: The Platform Admin did not approve this depot registration. Depot users cannot sign in while the registration is rejected.
rejected.next: Contact the Platform Admin if you need more information or want to correct your details.
rejected.contact: Please have your depot name, owner name, and phone number ready when you contact the Platform Admin.

suspended.title: Depot suspended
suspended.message: This depot has been suspended. Depot users cannot sign in and active sessions are ended when they refresh.
suspended.next: Contact the Platform Admin to resolve the suspension.
suspended.contact: Please have your depot name and owner details ready when you contact the Platform Admin.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.message: Your role cannot open this page. The server also enforces this permission.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The numbers of your depot, from the sales, the stock, and the credit of today.
dashboard.chartWeekday: Sales by day of the week
dashboard.noData: There is no data for this period yet.
dashboard.noSlowMoving: Nothing is standing still: everything in stock was sold.
dashboard.timezoneNote: The days are the days of the depot (Asia/Phnom_Penh).

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group products so the catalog stays easy to browse.
categories.name: Category name
categories.archiveMessage: "{name}" will stay on existing products but cannot be used for new or edited products.
categories.emptyBody: Create a category to group your products.
categories.noResultsBody: Try a different search or status filter.
categories.loadError: We could not load the categories.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Search the catalog, manage units, and keep retail and wholesale prices up to date.
products.name: Product name
products.trackBatchesHint: Purchases for this product will require a batch number and expiry date.
products.created: The product was created. You can now add units, prices, and an image.
products.archiveMessage: "{name}" will stay readable for old records but cannot be used in new invoices or purchases.
products.emptyBody: Add your first product to start building the catalog.
products.noResultsBody: Try a different search, category, or status filter.
products.loadError: We could not load the products.
products.unitsSubtitle: Quantities are stored in the base unit. Add larger units with their conversion factor.
products.unitBaseHint: The base unit always has a factor of 1.
products.unitArchiveMessage: "{name}" will no longer be available for new prices or stock entries.
products.unitMax: You have reached the maximum of 20 extra units.
products.imageCreateHint: Save the product first, then add an image here.
products.priceSubtitle: Retail and wholesale price per unit. Only the owner can change prices.
products.priceHistoryNote: The API currently returns the current price and its last change date. Full change history will appear when the history endpoint is added.
products.roleReadOnly: Your role can view products and prices but cannot change them.
products.priceHistorySubtitle: Who changed each price, when, and the old and new amount.
products.priceHistoryEmpty: No price has been changed yet.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Create staff accounts, assign roles, and control access to your depot.
staff.newSubtitle: The staff member signs in with this email or phone and the initial password.
staff.editSubtitle: Update the account details and role.
staff.name: Full name
staff.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number. The staff member can change it after signing in.
staff.resetDone: The password was reset. The staff member must change it at next sign-in.
staff.deactivateMessage: "{name}" will no longer be able to sign in or refresh an active session.
staff.resetMessage: Set a temporary password for "{name}". The staff member must change it at next sign-in.
staff.emptyBody: Create the first staff account for this depot.
staff.roleHint: Sales can sell, stock keepers manage stock, and delivery staff handle deliveries.

settings.title: Depot settings
settings.subtitle: These details appear in your workspace and on printed invoices.
settings.readOnlyNote: Only the depot owner can change these settings. You can read them here for invoices and reports.
settings.name: Depot name
settings.namePlaceholder: For example, Boeng Keng Kong Depot
settings.addressPlaceholder: Street, city, and other address details
settings.currencyHint: Three-letter ISO 4217 code, for example KHR or USD.
settings.languageHint: The default language for this depot. Your own interface language is changed from the top bar.
settings.invoiceFooterPlaceholder: Text printed at the bottom of invoices
settings.logoUploadFailed: Settings were not saved because the logo upload failed. Fix the error above and try again.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
password.forcedNote: Your password was reset by an owner or administrator. Choose a new password before using the workspace.
password.hint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
password.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current password.

platform.title: Depot review
platform.subtitle: Review registrations and manage depot access. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
platform.approveMessage: "{name}" will be able to sign in and use its depot workspace.
platform.rejectMessage: Users of "{name}" will not be able to sign in. Give a clear reason for the audit log.
platform.suspendMessage: Users of "{name}" will not be able to sign in or refresh their session. Give a clear reason for the audit log.
platform.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the decision for the audit log
platform.emptyBody: There are no depots with this status.
platform.loadError: We could not load the depot list.
platform.actionError: The action could not be completed.
platform.planDialogTitle: Change the plan of the depot
platform.planDialogMessage: The depot {name} moves to the plan you pick. The change is written to the audit log of the depot.
platform.planChanged: The plan of the depot was changed.

errors.network: We cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
errors.notFound: The requested record was not found.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.identifierTaken: That email address or phone number is already registered.
errors.planUserLimit: Your plan allows at most {max} active users. Deactivate a staff member or upgrade the plan.
errors.planUserLimitOne: Your plan allows at most 1 active user. Deactivate a staff member or upgrade the plan.

errors.planProductLimit: Your plan allows at most {max} active products. Archive a product or upgrade the plan.
errors.planProductLimitOne: Your plan allows at most 1 active product. Archive a product or upgrade the plan.
